correctness.rationale: The complete 15-bit complex comprises exactly 3,480 nonempty simplices with face vector (15,105,420,990,1260,690). Executed from the embedded package source, the reproducible priority-toggle matching yields exactly 1,694 valid disjoint pairs and leaves 1 critical vertex and 91 critical 5-simplices. Complete Hasse-graph orientation across 15,870 incidences admits topological sorting all 3,480 cells, proving acyclicity. The CW Morse model has no attaching target above dimension 0 for its 5-cells; hence integral homotopy is a wedge of 91 S5. An independent reconstruction yields mod-2 boundary ranks (14,91,329,661,599). The finite matching proof, not field homology alone, establishes the claim.

value.rationale: The 3 by 5 uniform-capacity-two board is a canonical finite chessboard-with-multiplicities complex and natural next rectangular case of a classical open-ended bipartite homotopy problem. Its complete integral homotopy type and explicit matching witness are not supplied by known rational representation formulas. The 91-dimensional top homotopy multiplicity contrasts sharply with the known 3 by 4 single-sphere case. Exact full attaching-map control is a nontrivial topological invariant beyond counts; no broad family theorem is claimed.
